'''Brian Kallenbach Scum & Villainy''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Kallenbach]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber]]
* '''Strategy:''' Scum & Villainy
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Scum & Villainy Kallenbach DS 1998.txt |Download]]
